name: @violin/dsp-ts
description: Shared, platform-agnostic TypeScript port of packages/dsp-native's validated YIN pitch-detection pipeline (YIN detector, harmonicity/HNR confidence gate, RMS silence/onset segmentation, input-gain clipping detection, hop-buffering). No DOM/Node/React-Native imports in its shipped source -- safe to run inside apps/desktop's AudioWorkletProcessor and apps/mobile's audio capture callback alike. Originally built inside apps/desktop during Phase 3; promoted to this shared package in Phase 4 so apps/mobile can reuse it instead of re-porting the algorithm a second time. See CLAUDE.md.
